description: ZeptoClaw: Email Sender Spoofing to bypass Header-Only From Allowlist Validation
how_introduced: This atomic feature-branch commit is the culprit sub-commit inside the squash and independently contains the vulnerable implementation. Its diff adds `EmailChannel`, extracts `from` via `parsed.from().and_then(...address())`, gates inbound mail with `is_sender_allowed(&from)`, and then uses that same header-derived value as sender identity. That is the exact design the later fix warns about, so this sub-commit is also a real introduction point for the vulnerable code.
